I can’t see real-time weather data for Berlin from here.  

To get the current conditions quickly, you can check:
- https://weather.com/ (search “Berlin, Germany”)
- https://www.dwd.de/ (German Weather Service)
- Google: “weather Berlin”

If you tell me your exact Berlin area (e.g., Mitte, Kreuzberg) and what you care about (temp, rain, wind), I can help interpret the forecast and suggest what to wear.
